authority: scoped Ghidra static decompilation of preserved runtime snapshot; no current game execution

rules.arithmetic: All floating conversions/operations are float32 in machine expression order; signed int conversion truncates toward zero. L*L is signed i32 before conversion.
rules.level: Constructor final int level stored at +0x30; get_Level returns it unchanged.
rules.def: unless property32 fixedDef: trunc(f32(L) * f32(f32(rawDef)/100f)); then unbroken parts add, BuffManager type2 multiplicative percent, abnormalState10 half.
rules.mdef: unless property32 fixedMdef: trunc(f32(L) * f32(f32(rawMdef)/100f)); then unbroken parts add, BuffManager type3 multiplicative percent, abnormalState10 half.
rules.necessaryHit: unless property32 fixedNecessaryHit: trunc(f32(f32(L)*1.5f) * f32(f32(rawHit)/100f)); then unbroken parts add.
rules.cutAttack: unless property32 fixedCutAttack: rawCutAttack - trunc(f32(L)*(-0.03999999910593033f)); then unbroken parts CutBonus add.
rules.cutMagicAttack: unless property32 fixedCutMagicAttack: rawCutMagicAttack - trunc(f32(L)*(-0.03999999910593033f)); then unbroken parts CutBonus add.
rules.maxHp: unless property32 fixedHp: trunc(f32(f32(f32(rawHp)/100f) * f32(f32(f32(L+81) + f32(f32(i32(L*L))/2.4000000953674316f)) * f32(f32(f32(L)/10f)+30f))) * (L>149 ?1.5f:1f)); fixed flag returns rawHp.
rules.exceptionMasks: property type32; first selected data.Values[0] low byte bits HP=1 hit=2 def=4 mdef=8 cutAttack=16 cutMagicAttack=32.
rules.levelUI: HighRaidBossMasterData.BaseLevel(+0x28) initializes selected level and base; MinLevel(+0x2a) initializes lower bound. FunctionLimitManager.GetValue(GameSystemFlag.LevelLimit=15,out upperBound) sets upper bound. If upperBound<=MinLevel or BaseLevel<MinLevel selected=MinLevel. +/-5 and +/-10 handlers clamp to these bounds.
rules.partsDef: For each registered unbroken part separately: its OWN property32 bit4 selects rawPartDef, otherwise trunc(f32(f32(rawPartDef)/100f)*f32(level)). Sum rounded values, not raw values before rounding.
rules.partsMdef: For each registered unbroken part separately: its OWN property32 bit8 selects rawPartMdef, otherwise trunc(f32(f32(rawPartMdef)/100f)*f32(level)). Sum rounded values, not raw values before rounding.
rules.partsHit: Own property32 bit2 selects rawPartHit, otherwise trunc(f32(f32(f32(f32(rawPartHit)/100f)*f32(level))*1.5f)); single final truncation.
rules.partsRegistration: HighRaidBossActionManager.SetPartsMaster(byte id,master,hp) constructs HighRaidMobPartsStatus with selected level, then forwards to status.SetPartsMaster(id,part). The latter requires owning master.parts contains id and inserts/replaces; neither function filters id>0. Actual upstream call coverage/part activation remains unknown.
rules.exceptionSelection: MobPropertyBase.GetValue() takes no UID and returns index0 for nonempty IList, otherwise first enumerator record. TryAddProperty appends, base CheckAddable returns1; HighRaidCalcExceptionFlag has no CheckAddable override. Thus first accepted type32 insertion record supplies flags. Pipeline raw parsing insertion ordering must be checked separately before equating with Array.find.

limitations: No current game process accessed. No active runtime proof.
No server FunctionLimitManager table captured; numeric maximum unknown. Do not invent level cap.
No HP overflow/large-level range extrapolation guarantee.
Parts/buff/status-dependent final stats must not be advertised as static universal totals.
Upstream part registration call coverage not proven; all raw part references are a static unbroken-parts baseline, not observed active scene objects.
